name: reel-watchlist
description: Reel — a movie watchlist with live streaming availability (TMDB / JustWatch)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
